# PART 3 – Data management and the reproduction {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. This is the part in which the R work reaches its target. We start with data management: the file that the original authors published, the file that the course built from it, the three different things that a missing value means in these data, and the scripts that connect a raw file to an analysis. Then the five analysts who reanalysed the claim from that same public file, and you choose one of them and reproduce the value that Multi100 recorded, which takes exactly the data work that the first half of the part covers.
:::
